save_failed.text: Could not save the changes in open files.
save_failed.hint: Wait a second, make sure the editor shows no save error, then try again.

bundle_invalid.text: This file does not look like a Studio project file.
bundle_invalid.hint: It may have been damaged in transit. Ask for it to be exported again.

bundle_prerequisites_missing.text: An earlier file or a full export is needed.
bundle_prerequisites_missing.hint: This file builds on versions that are not in the project. Ask your colleague to export the whole project.

unrelated_histories.text: This file belongs to a different project.
unrelated_histories.hint: Its version history is unrelated, so it cannot be merged into this project. Check that you picked the right file.

not_a_studio_project.text: There is no Studio project in this file.
not_a_studio_project.hint: Pick a file that was exported with the "Export bundle" command.

network_error.hint: Check your connection and try again.

card.lead: Pass the project to a colleague without a server: export it to a file and send it any way you like, by e-mail, in a messenger or on a USB stick. A file from a colleague is merged into the project the same way as a sync.

export.title: Export bundle
export.text: The whole project with its version history in one file. You can protect it with a password.

import.title: Import bundle
import.text: A file from a colleague adds their versions to the project. Your versions stay.
import.readOnly: The project is open read-only, so a file cannot be imported.

ci.lead: The Studio prepares a file that lets GitHub or GitLab build your documents into PDF after every change. The file reaches the repository on the next sync, and you can download the PDFs from the service.

export.title: Export the project to a file
export.description: One file with the project and its whole version history.
export.explain: You can send the file to a colleague any way you like. They import it in the Studio and get the project with its history, and later exchanges merge your edits. No server connection is needed.
export.loading: Checking what goes into the file…
export.protectHint: Without a password anyone who gets the file can read it.
export.passwordHint: The Studio does not store the password and cannot recover it. Give it to your colleague separately from the file.
export.nda: The project has NDA files. Without a password anyone who gets the file can read them.
export.saveFailed: Could not save the changes in open files, so the export was stopped. Try again in a second.
export.failed: The project could not be exported. Try again.

done.title: File saved
done.text: Your browser downloaded the file. Send it to your colleague: they import it in the "File exchange" section of the project settings or when cloning a project.
done.passwordNote: Give the password separately from the file. If it is lost, the file cannot be opened.

import.title: Import a project file
import.description: Versions from the file are added to the project, and yours stay in place.
import.explain: Choose the .bundle or .hseenc file your colleague sent. The Studio checks it and merges it into the project the same way as a sync. If you both changed the same place, it asks you which version to keep.
import.passwordHint: The password was set when the file was exported. The Studio does not store it.
import.cancelled: Import cancelled. Choose a file and try again when you are ready.
import.lost: Cannot find out how the import is going. The connection may have dropped.

progress.label: Import steps
progress.upload: Sending the file to the Studio
progress.lead: The Studio is checking the file and merging it into the project. You can close this window when it finishes.

up_to_date.title: Nothing new in the file
up_to_date.text: Every version in the file is already in the project, so nothing changed.

fast_forwarded.title: Versions from the file added
fast_forwarded.text: The project had no differences from the file, so it was simply updated.

merged.title: File merged into the project
merged.text: Versions from the file are added and yours stay. Whatever did not overlap, the Studio merged on its own.

conflicts.title: Conflicts need your decision
conflicts.text: Some files were changed both by you and in the file. Choose what to keep in each. Files with conflicts: {{count}}.

ci.title: Automatic builds (CI)
ci.description: A file for GitHub or GitLab: the service builds your documents into PDF after every change.
ci.writeFailed: The file could not be written. Try again.

docs.failed: Could not load the list of documents.
docs.empty: The project has no documents yet.

artifacts.label: Artifacts
artifacts.hint: PDFs are kept in the results of each build and can be downloaded for a while.

release.label: Release
release.hint: PDFs are attached to a release when you push a tag like v1.0. They are kept there permanently.

problem.no_triggers: Choose at least one way to start a build.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.imageHint: If left empty, the image that matches this version of the Studio is used.

preview.invalid: Fix the settings on the left and the file appears here.

exists.same: This file is already written in the project. Nothing needs to change.
exists.differs: The project already has a file with this name and it differs. Writing the new one replaces the old one.

nda.warning: The project has NDA files. A build on GitHub or GitLab sends the project contents to third parties.
nda.ack: I understand this and still want to set up automatic builds

local.title: Run the same build yourself
local.hint: You can run this command on your computer and get the same result as the service.

done.title: File written to the project
done.text: It reaches the repository on the next sync. After that the service builds the documents on its own.
done.nothingText: The file in the project differs and the replacement was not confirmed. Go back to the settings and tick the replacement.
